title: Mixing: Wings Over The World by Wings | 1978
content:
Studio Two, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producers: Paul McCartney, Chris Thomas

The third of five mixing sessions for the Wings Over The World documentary took place on 6 November 1978.

The songs mixed on this day were performances of ‘Go Now’, ‘Let ’Em In’, ‘Silly Love Songs’, ‘Beware My Love’, and ‘Band On The Run’.

Page last updated: 29 January 2026
